sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Measurement of serum free testosterone based on total serum testosterone (CPT code 84403**), sex hormone binding globulin (SHBG) (CPT code 84270) or bioavailable testosterone (CPT code 84410*) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following conditions: – Acromegaly – Acute and chronic kidney failure – Benign prostatic hypertrophy – Cirrhosis or hepatitis – Diabetes mellitus – Erectile dysfunction – Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) disease – Hyperthyroidism – Hypothyroidism – Infertility – Nephrotic syndrome – Obesity – Polymorphisms – Use of estrogens – Use of glucocorticoids, progestins or androgenic steroids • Testing for serum total testosterone measurements (CPT code 84403**) IS REIMBURSABLE at the designated frequency in any of the following situations: – For individuals taking enzyme inhibitors for prostate cancer: as needed – For individuals receiving testosterone replacement therapy: up to eight tests every four years – Gender-dysphoric or gender-incongruent persons: as needed – Infertility: as needed – Symptomatic individuals being evaluated for polycystic ovary syndrome or functional hypothalamic amenorrhea: as needed • Measurement of serum dihydrotestosterone (CPT code 82642) IS REIMBURSABLE for diagnosing 5-alpha reductase deficiency in individuals with ambiguous genitalia, hypospadias or microphallus. • Measurement of serum estradiol (CPT code 82670, CPT code 82681) IS REIMBURSABLE for the following conditions at the designated frequency: – For individuals with gynecomastia: once per lifetime – For individuals who are experiencing infertility: as needed • Testing for serum total testosterone (CPT code 84403**), free testosterone (CPT code 84402) or bioavailable testosterone (CPT code 84410*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in asymptomatic individuals or in individuals with non-specific symptoms.

subsections.heading: Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans
content: **The payment criterion for 84403 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Palmetto GBA.
